description: Surface and switch between versions of a page over time. Data from inline JSON, a data-src manifest or the vb:versions-manifest meta tag; a trigger + picker popover; three actions (navigate / swap / diff). Mode (releases vs history) is derived from the data. Entry URLs are scheme-checked (javascript:/data: entries dropped); swap and diff fetch same-origin URLs only and swapped markup is sanitized.

attributes.name: data-versions
attributes.description: Inline JSON array of version entries: { id, label?, url?, date?, author?, summary?, archived?, draft?, current?, versionUrl? }. Alternative: a <script type="application/json" data-versions> child. Entries whose url is a script/data URL are dropped; an unsafe versionUrl drops only the changelog link. Stripped by the untrusted sanitizer profile.

attributes.name: data-src
attributes.description: URL of a JSON manifest (same entry shape) fetched when no inline data is provided. Falls back to <meta name="vb:versions-manifest"> if neither is set. Stripped by the untrusted sanitizer profile.

attributes.name: data-mode
attributes.description: Override the derived mode: releases (entries have distinct URLs) or history (entries share one URL). Sets the picker heading; observed.

attributes.name: data-action
attributes.description: navigate sets location.href to the entry url (skipped, with an error event, when that url is the current page); swap fetches the same-origin entry url and replaces the versioned region in place (sanitized, view-transition crossfade); diff mounts a <change-set> line diff beside the versioned region.

attributes.name: data-versioned-region
attributes.description: CSS selector for the swappable / diffable region (default: "[data-versioned], main")

attributes.name: data-diff-position
attributes.description: Where to mount the diff render relative to the versioned region.

attributes.name: data-banner
attributes.description: Render an archived-version notice (an <aside> with a polite status line, filled after insertion so it is announced) when the current entry is archived AND a non-archived latest exists; the latest is a link only when it has a safe url.

attributes.name: data-page-info-target
attributes.description: ID of a <page-info> to mount inside as a section in its expandable panel; the standalone trigger is hidden in this mode. The section is removed when the switcher disconnects.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: What the switcher picks (e.g. "API version"). Not applied to the host (it has no role): it names the trigger ("API version: v2.1") and the picker dialog. Falls back to data-label-trigger.

attributes.name: data-label-trigger
attributes.description: Fallback name for the trigger / picker when no aria-label is set, and trigger text with no current entry.

attributes.name: data-label-loading
attributes.description: Trigger text while the manifest is fetched.

attributes.name: data-label-loading-versions
attributes.description: Trigger title and panel row while the manifest is fetched.

attributes.name: data-label-empty
attributes.description: Empty-state row and disabled-trigger title.

attributes.name: data-label-heading-releases
attributes.description: Picker / panel heading in releases mode.

attributes.name: data-label-heading-history
attributes.description: Picker / panel heading in history mode.

attributes.name: data-label-archived
attributes.description: Archived badge.

attributes.name: data-label-draft
attributes.description: Draft badge.

attributes.name: data-label-current
attributes.description: Current badge.

attributes.name: data-label-by
attributes.description: Author line ({author}).

attributes.name: data-label-changelog
attributes.description: Changelog link text.

attributes.name: data-label-changelog-for
attributes.description: Changelog link accessible name ({version}).

attributes.name: data-label-banner-label
attributes.description: Banner landmark name.

attributes.name: data-label-banner
attributes.description: Banner status text ({version}).

attributes.name: data-label-banner-latest
attributes.description: Banner latest link / text ({version}).

attributes.name: data-label-diff
attributes.description: Caption above the diff render ({from}, {to}).

events.name: version-switcher:select
events.description: Fires when an entry is selected (before the action runs)

events.name: version-switcher:before-navigate
events.description: Cancellable. Fires before location.href is set (only for a safe url that is not the current page); preventDefault() blocks navigation.

events.name: version-switcher:before-swap
events.description: Cancellable. Fires before swap fetches (same-origin only) and replaces the versioned region.

events.name: version-switcher:swap
events.description: Fires after swap completes: versioned region replaced (sanitized) and <meta itemprop="version"> updated.

events.name: version-switcher:before-diff
events.description: Cancellable. Fires before diff fetches the other version.

events.name: version-switcher:diff
events.description: Fires after diff renders. diffElement is the mounted <change-set>.

events.name: version-switcher:error
events.description: Parse / fetch / action failure, a dropped unsafe entry, a cross-origin swap/diff url, or a navigate to the current page.

childAttributes.name: data-versions
childAttributes.description: Marks a <script type="application/json"> child as the versions JSON source

methods.name: switchTo(id)
methods.description: Programmatic selection; fires select then runs data-action.

methods.name: refresh()
methods.description: Re-resolve the data source and re-render.
